description.value: Barnside Brewing is a true farm-based destination brewery in Ladner (Delta), BC, crafting award-winning beers from hops and grains grown on the surrounding family farms. The taproom occupies a converted heritage barn with century-old beams and a four-season patio overlooking the hop yards, making it an unusually atmospheric rural stop. The brewery has roots going back to 1899 and produces a full range of craft lagers, ales, and sours alongside a farm-focused food menu.
